results.name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the end of the landmine barbell at your side with your arm straight and your core engaged.
Slowly bend your torso toward the barbell while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement without twisting your shoulders or hips.
Squeeze your obliques to return to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your working arm straight without shrugging your shoulder.
Keep your knees slightly bent to improve balance and stability.
Keep your torso facing forward throughout the movement. Move only through your waist and avoid rotating your shoulders or hips.
Exhale as you return to the upright position and inhale as you bend sideways.
results.description: Barbell Landmine Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Back, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and hold a barbell directly above your chest with your arms fully extended, hands at shoulder width apart.
Keep the barbell locked out overhead as you raise your upper body into a seated position, using your core.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your arms straight and the barbell stable overhead.
Lower your torso back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended throughout the exercise for stability.
Maintain a straight bar path directly above your shoulders throughout the movement.
Use your abdominal muscles to crunch into a seated position. Control the lowering phase to maximize core engagement.
Inhale as you lower your torso and exhale as you sit up.
results.description: Barbell Situp is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, performing a crunch.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your chin slightly tucked to maintain a neutral spine position and prevent neck strain.
Focus on squeezing your abdominal muscles at the top of the crunch to enhance muscle engagement.
Breathe out as you lift your body and breathe in as you lower it to maintain a steady rhythm and maximize oxygen flow.
results.description: Bench Decline Ab Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bench Knee Tucks
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands placed beside your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor with your legs extended straight out.
Pull your knees towards your chest, tucking them in while engaging your core.
Extend your legs back out to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper form.
Avoid using momentum; focus on using your abdominal muscles to pull your knees in.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you tuck your knees in and inhaling as you extend your legs out.
results.description: Bench Knee Tucks is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bicycles Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs lifted off the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while extending your left leg out.
Simultaneously twist your torso, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Alternate sides, bringing your left knee towards your chest and your right elbow towards your left knee, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to perform the twist, rather than your neck or shoulders.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your elbows wide and avoid pulling on your head to prevent neck strain.
results.description: Bicycles Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Bicycles
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs bent and lifted off the floor, and both arms straight to the floor.
Bring your right knee towards your chest while straightening your left leg towards the floor without letting it touch the floor.
Alternate sides by bringing your left knee towards your chest and straightening your right leg towards the floor, continuing in a controlled, bicycle-like motion.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to control the movement of your legs.
Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to prevent strain.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and avoid injury.
results.description: Bicycles is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Brazilian Crunches
instructions: Begin in a plank position on your toes and hands, arms straight in line with shoulders, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your left elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Return your leg to starting position.

Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bending your left knee and bringing it towards your right elbow while lightly rotating your hips. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements controlled to ensure each repetition is deliberate and effective.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you bring your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the plank.
Focus on maintaining proper plank form, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
results.description: Brazilian Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Stand facing away from a high cable pulley with the rope positioned behind your neck. Hold the rope with arms beside your head with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Contract your abdominal muscles and curl your torso downward by bringing your rib cage toward your pelvis while keeping your hips nearly stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom while squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return your torso to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hands beside your head without pulling on the rope with your arms.
Flex your spine to initiate the movement instead of hinging at your hips.
Keep your neck in a neutral position and avoid excessive forward head movement.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you curl your torso downward.
results.description: Cable Standing Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and rest your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Place your top leg on a bench at knee or ankle height, with your bottom leg hanging free underneath.
Press your forearm and top leg down to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line, and raise your bottom leg toward the bench.
Hold the position while breathing steadily, then lower your hips with control and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked; don't let them roll forward or back.
Start with the bench under your knee and progress to the ankle as you get stronger.
results.description: Copenhagen Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Dead Bug Extended Arms
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back, right arm extended overhead on the floor in line with your torso and left arm extended by your side. Right knee bent close to your chest, while the left leg is bent and lightly extended away from your hips level, keeping both lower legs parallel to the floor.

In a semi circular motion bring your right arm to your side while slowly extending your right leg to pass your hip level and simultaneously bring your left arm in a semi circular motion extended overhead on the floor in line with your torso and your left knee closer to your chest.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm and leg, lowering the arm extended by your side and the opposite leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lower your arm and leg and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Avoid letting your leg touch the floor; keep it just above the floor to maintain tension in your muscles.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
results.description: Dead Bug Extended Arms is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.
